messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['This is an official notification from PayPal that the service listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renewed immediately.', 'This is your official notification that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renew immediately.', 'Once we are able to charge your card and receive payment for your account balance, we will re-activate your ads.', 'If this purchasing was made by someone else, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the sign-up options in this letter, and then change the password on your profile, maybe it was stolen.', 'If this sign up was made by someone else, and you want to unsubscribe, click on the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your profile, supposedly it was stolen.', 'To ensure that your service is not interrupted, please update your billing info today by clicking here https://billings.aol.com', "Canceling your account means your profile and all your content will be removed from Myspace and you can't get it back!", 'You will lose access to your current AOL Desktop software in 7 days.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We notify you of service deactivation, billing issues, and subscription changes, urging prompt payment, account updates, cancellation, or renewal to maintain access."}
